title: Copilot Studio: computer use for web browsing on the Microsoft Copilot harness
summary: Hold: the spending guidance overstates what the controls contain and omits qualifications needed to set reliable limits. Agent limits are not instantaneous, do not stop called agent flows, and cannot be set before an agent has consumed credits; existing maker permissions are also documented governance levers.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Governance controls: Stop usage paragraph; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Stop usage turns an agent off at its monthly limit, presented as the workload spending stopping point without qualifications.
claims.quote: An agent's monthly limit doesn't stop the agent flows that the agent calls. ... Limits aren't applied instantly. An agent can continue to respond for some time after it reaches its limit, so set limits and notification thresholds with some margin.
claims.fix: Replace the Stop usage explanation in controls[1].note and the prose with: 'Turn on Stop usage to turn the agent off after it reaches its monthly limit. Enforcement is not instantaneous, so allow margin; the limit does not stop agent flows the agent calls, which are billed and checked for capacity separately.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/manage-copilot-studio-copilot-credits-capacity#manage-monthly-consumption-limits-for-copilot-studio-agents.

claims.claim: Shared environment capacity controls apply across Copilot Studio, not only to Microsoft Copilot harness browsing.
claims.quote: The capacity and consumption controls in the Power Platform admin center apply across Copilot Studio. They aren't exclusive to the Microsoft Copilot harness.

claims.claim: Changes to either row 1 or row 2 affect other agents, workflows and features in the same environment.
claims.quote: An agent-level limit helps contain a single workload, while the environment configuration determines which capacity sources are available to all workloads in the environment.
claims.fix: Replace 'They apply across Copilot Studio, not only to this feature, so changes affect other agents, workflows and features in the same environment.' with 'These controls are available across Copilot Studio, not only for this feature. Changes to shared environment capacity in row 1 can affect other agents, workflows and features in that environment; row 2 sets a limit for the selected agent.'
